account: Taiwan's SETN reported on 21 Jan 2026, citing Japanese media, on a sightseeing helicopter operated by Aso Cadre Dominion. It carried a pilot in his sixties and two Taiwanese passengers (a 41-year-old man and a 36-year-old woman). It took off at 10:52 Japan time on 20 Jan 2026 and lost contact at 11:04. Before contact was lost, the local fire department received a “strong impact” notification from a passenger's phone, apparently the iPhone Crash Detection feature. Callbacks to the phone failed. An object believed to be the helicopter was found around the first crater of Mount Aso's Nakadake. The article does not state the fate of the three occupants. It does not cite a named Japanese agency. It quotes a firefighter and a nurse on crash detection in general. Apple's feature, on iPhone 14 and later, uses motion sensors and an on-device algorithm to call emergency services after a 10-second countdown. The OECD AI Incidents Monitor lists the case as a protective response. The link to transport safety is indirect. The device alerted responders to an aviation crash it did not prevent.

The report does not establish that the alert’s coordinates guided the discovery or that anyone was rescued alive.

fields.account: Taiwan's SETN reported on 21 Jan 2026, citing Japanese media, on a sightseeing helicopter operated by Aso Cadre Dominion. It carried a pilot in his sixties and two Taiwanese passengers (a 41-year-old man and a 36-year-old woman). It took off at 10:52 Japan time on 20 Jan 2026 and lost contact at 11:04. Before contact was lost, the local fire department received a “strong impact” notification from a passenger's phone, apparently the iPhone Crash Detection feature. Callbacks to the phone failed. An object believed to be the helicopter was found around the first crater of Mount Aso's Nakadake. The article does not state the fate of the three occupants. It does not cite a named Japanese agency. It quotes a firefighter and a nurse on crash detection in general. Apple's feature, on iPhone 14 and later, uses motion sensors and an on-device algorithm to call emergency services after a 10-second countdown. The OECD AI Incidents Monitor lists the case as a protective response. The link to transport safety is indirect. The device alerted responders to an aviation crash it did not prevent.
